prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
A good starting point is **Business Needs Craftsmanship**: BBB lists it as accredited with an **A+ rating**, and its services include kitchen and bathroom remodels, additions, decks, basement work, and home repairs. It serves Joplin.

- **Phone:** (816) 599-1292  
- **Address:** 218 S. Main St., Joplin, MO 64801  
- [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/general-contractor/business-needs-craftsmanship-0734-1000011969)

For a larger general-contracting project, **American Construction Inc.** is another local option; its website says it has served Joplin since 1993 and lists remodeling, bathrooms, basements, and carpentry among its work.

- **Phone:** (417) 781-6811  
- [Website](https://www.americanconstructionincorporated.com/)

These are leads, not guarantees. Before hiring, get at least three written bids, ask for recent references and proof of insurance, confirm who will handle permits, and agree on a written scope, payment schedule, and change-order process.
